hero.title: The Ecosystem Strategy
hero.subtitle: Building a comprehensive digital universe, not just a portfolio.

vision.title: The Vision
vision.description: My goal is to build a complete digital ecosystem. It's not enough to just have a static portfolio. I wanted a structure that supports my freelance work, my learning journey, and my experimental side projects, all interconnected.

hub.title: The Central Hub
hub.description: At the center of everything lies poyrazavsever.com. This is the gateway. It serves as the main showcase for my work, case studies, and professional identity. From here, users are routed to specialized subdomains based on their intent.
hub.caption: Fig 1. The Hub-and-Spoke Topology of the Ecosystem.

items.name: portal.poyrazavsever.com
items.description: The client interface. Here, freelancers and sponsors can log in to track project progress, view invoices, and manage collaboration.

items.name: status.poyrazavsever.com
items.description: Transparency is key. This dashboard monitors the health of all my services and APIs in real-time.

items.name: ui.poyrazavsever.com
items.description: Poyraz UI Kit. A dedicated space for my custom design system. Every component used in my projects is documented here to ensure brand consistency.

items.name: js.poyrazavsever.com
items.description: My learning garden. This is where I share my notes, lab experiments, and code snippets from my ongoing learning journey.

journeys.title: User Journeys
journeys.description: Different users interact with the ecosystem in different ways. A client needs streamlined access to project data, while a developer might be interested in my open-source contributions or learning notes.
journeys.caption: Fig 2. User Journey flows for Clients and Learners.

plan.title: Detailed Structure Plan
plan.description: We are currently fleshing out the detailed navigation for the Hub. Sections like Showcase, Client Portal, Products, and Career & Life will organize the vast content of this ecosystem.
